evidence: NCSCM's CZMP 2019 Maharashtra service publishes a 'Survey Plots' layer whose rows carry the City Survey village, plot type (CTS or TPS), municipal ward and the published plot label.
A 2024 copy of the same plots tags every Greater Mumbai row with one of Mumbai's eleven City Survey Offices (research/mumbai-deep-2026-10-13.json).

descriptor.name: NCSCM CZMP 2019 — Maharashtra survey plots (Mumbai)
descriptor.scope: City survey (CTS) and town-planning-scheme (TPS) plots drawn on Maharashtra's Coastal Zone Management Plan 2019 maps, which cover Greater Mumbai's eleven City Survey Offices. Labels repeat within a village, so application references are derived from each outline and change when an outline changes.
descriptor.attribution: National Centre for Sustainable Coastal Management (MoEFCC) — CZMP 2019 survey plots, Maharashtra. Plot labels shown as published; references derived from geometry. Adapted to WGS84.
descriptor.licenceNote: No reuse licence is stated on the CZMP portal or the ArcGIS service; the plan is published for public viewing.
caveats: Coastal-zone planning maps, not the land-records register: plot outlines are a geometry reference, not proof of current title or ownership.
The layer mixes CTS and TPS plots. VILLAGE + TYPE + label repeats for distinct polygons, so it is shown, never used as identity; OBJECTID is a transport field.

Application identity uses the source namespace plus canonical geometry SHA-256 at 1e-7-degree precision and a spatial locator, as for Nairobi. A changed outline gets a new reference; absence means that outline version was not returned.
The service answers browsers directly (CORS allows this site); no relay is used.
The plan dates from the CRZ Notification 2019; the survey date of the underlying plot maps is not stated.
